name: interlace
description: Skills for adding security linting to JavaScript and TypeScript projects, from the Interlace ESLint plugins.

plugins.name: interlace
plugins.description: Adds security linting to a Node.js, TypeScript, React, NestJS or Express project: keeps eslint-plugin-security, writes an ESLint 9/10 flat config, and adds the Interlace plugins that match the stack.
